title: First Lessons: the Veil
introNarration: Mentor Mist does not fill the silence. Pale curtains take the light and give it back in pieces. The dark mirror waits where a first-year will want to look too long. "Look this hearth. Name what moved. Then find Flint in the South Orchard. Attack the dummy once. Come back."
reminderNarration: Silence keeps well. Look the Hearth of the Veil — the mirror, the path that will not go straight. Visit the South Orchard. Attack the dummy. Then talk Mist.
completionNarration: Mist almost smiles. The Veil has your name, if not yet your silence. The kit is open. Alder waits in the High Study with a question about the bell below.

objectives.label: Look around the Hearth of the Veil.
